title: Resetting a forgotten password
text: If you forgot your password or cannot log in, open the sign-in page, choose 'Forgot password' and follow the reset link we email you. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

title: Refund policy
text: Duplicate charges and billing errors are refunded to the original card after review by the billing team. A refund never exceeds the amount of the invoice it relates to.

title: Service status and outages
text: During an outage or when the API is down, check the status page. Enterprise customers have a dedicated incident channel and are contacted by the on-call engineer.

title: Suspended and locked accounts
text: An account is suspended and locked when an invoice is overdue. Paying the overdue invoice from the billing page restores access within a few minutes.

title: Changing your plan
text: You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from the subscription settings. Changes take effect at the start of the next billing month.
